item.title: CSAF and CMSAF join Air University’s PCTT panel
item.description: Air Force Chief of Staff Gen. Ken Wilsbach and Chief Master Sgt. of the Air Force David Wolfe, accompanied by their wives, Mrs. Cindy Wilsbach and Dr. Doniel Wolfe, visited Maxwell Air Force Base, Alabama, to provide senior leader perspectives to new Wing and Group command teams and their spouses during Air University’s Pre-Command Team Training Jan. 29.

item.title: Photo Story: 120th Field Artillery Soldiers conduct winter sling-load ops with Black Hawk, Chinook helicopters, Part 1
item.description: Soldiers with the Wisconsin National Guard's 120th Field Artillery conduct winter sling-load operations Jan. 28, 2026, at Fort McCoy, Wis., with support from UH-60 Black Hawks and a CH-47 Chinook helicopters from the 2nd Battalion, 147th Aviation Regiment of the Minnesota National Guard.

item.title: D.C. Safe and Beautiful Mission Adapts to Winter While Soldiers Coordinate with Authorities for Greater Impact
item.description: Joint Task Force District of Columbia continues the D.C. Safe and Beautiful mission as the ongoing recovery from Winter Storm Fern's heavy snow and disruptions continues. Georgia National Guard members, now patrolling Anacostia, coordinate with local authorities to enhance safety, share community insights, and support beautification efforts.

item.title: Command Presence on the Streets of Washington
item.description: During a winter ride-along through Washington, D.C., senior leaders of Joint Task Force–District of Columbia observe the D.C. Safe and Beautiful mission unfolding at street level, where prevention and presence define success. As Command Sgt. Maj. Scott McKennon and Col. Larry Doane engage Soldiers and Airmen on post, routine radio traffic, quiet coordination and uneventful outcomes reveal a mission working as intended. item.title: From drill pad to drill weekend, former MTIs from 2nd Bomb Wing prepare future 307th BW Airmen
item.description: Master Sgt. Ashley Henderson, 307th Bomb Wing development and training flight coordinator, coordinated outreach to former military training instructors from 2nd Bomb Wing, leveraging feedback to enhance flight drill instruction and ceremony preparation for Basic Military Training.

item.title: Space-A: Unused seats into unforgettable journeys
item.description: For many service members, veterans, and military families dreaming of traveling the world, that opportunity has officially landed in the form of an empty seat. The Space Availability program, commonly known as Space-A, offers passengers the opportunity to fly aboard military aircraft. The Space-A terminal will open Feb. 1, 2026 at the Charlotte Air National Guard base, Charlotte, N.C.

item.title: Headline Handoff: The 137th Military Police Detachment Executes Change of Responsibility
item.description: In a ceremony held today, the 137th Military Police Detachment conducted a change-of-responsibility ceremony, marking a leadership transition within the unit.

item.title: Called Home and Back: A Mother’s Return to Service
item.description: Even as a kid, I knew I wanted to serve in the Air Force. I never wanted anything more, except to one day be a mother. I guess I just never thought about how the two would work together.
